paras: Emoia cyclops, also known commonly as the Cyclops emo skink and Cyclop's skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Indonesia.
The specific name, cyclops, is a reference to the type locality which is the Cyclops Mountains.
E. cyclops is found in northern Papua Province, Indonesian New Guinea.
The preferred natural habitat of E. cyclops is forest, at altitudes of 1,100–1,200 m (3,600–3,900 ft).
